newsitem.title: USA: Johnston Industries says Q4 sales look good.
newsitem.headline: Johnston Industries says Q4 sales look good.

text.p: Johnston Industries Inc said Thursday the three main components necessary for its profitable growth crystallized during the third quarter and will continue into the fourth.
Sales started to increase, fiber prices improved and the benefits of its cost reduction program started during the first half, are being realized, the company said.
Sales increased by 5.6 percent in the third quarter, but the improvement started in September, later than anticipated, the company said.
Internally, the company said, sales uptick is reflected in increased unfilled residential contract upholstery orders, and the fact that all of Johnston's looms are running full-time.
The company said it is encouraged with the increased sales momentum, which is continuing in the fourth quarter, and looks for continued growth in 1997.
